attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own newsletter, written in his voice and endorsed.

semantics.note: 'Needs to convert by the end of the year or it's effectively dead' is an unhedged conditional: no conversion by end-2025 means effectively dead. Reading the company as OpenAI fits the context. The separate 'even if it does' claim about continual funding is correctly left out.

contract.note: Both the support and contradiction conditions require the antecedent (no conversion by 2025-12-31). Reading 'convert' as finishing the for-profit restructuring is reasonable. 'Effectively dead' is undefined, but that never matters because the antecedent failed.

evidence.note: OpenAI's own disclosure dated 2025-10-28 says its recapitalization was complete, before the deadline. It bears on the antecedent, not the outcome, so it cannot contradict the conditional. The drafter's 'contradicts' label is wrong; this is context. It is a company statement, not an independent finding.

output.rationale: This is a conditional forecast whose antecedent is no for-profit conversion by end-2025. The packet's only item, a company disclosure, says OpenAI finished its recapitalization on 2025-10-28, so the antecedent apparently did not happen. Under policy, a conditional whose antecedent failed or is unknown is not scored. Either way the 'effectively dead' consequent is never tested. The horizon has passed, and the outcome is not_adjudicable.
